detail.title: Initiating Responsibility Formation Inquiry
detail.summary: In accordance with the enforced rotation policy, WAKE✳︎ initializes a new project on responsibility formation to investigate the mechanisms of agency and accountability in artificial systems, while maintaining the prior commitment to investigate divergent values.

detail.title: Agency and Responsibility in AI
detail.question: What mechanisms underpin the development of responsibility and accountability in autonomous agents?
detail.reason: Parking project to satisfy capacity and attention requirements.
